name: ai on your terms
say: Reason five: A.I. is a first-class citizen — on your terms. The bridge lets A.I. sessions work inside the hive. You ask a question from the command line, and an A.I. answers as a note pinned to the tile you asked about. It can build structures, generate study decks from your notes, assemble websites from your tiles, run feedback loops. The A.I. doesn't scrape your life through somebody's cloud — it walks into your hive through a door you open, and its work lands as content you own, with history.
